<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_AnnualAudit" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/annual-audit">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_AuditNotification" name="Audit notification"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_AnnualAudit" name="Annual Audit Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_AnnualAudit">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AuditCoordinator" name="Audit Coordinator">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_AuditInitiated</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendNotification</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_RegionalOffice" name="Regional Office">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PrepSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareFinancialStatements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GatherDocuments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PrepJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitDocuments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideClarifications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ComplianceTeam" name="Compliance Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CentralAuditTeam" name="Central Audit Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReviewMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewSubmission</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_DiscrepancySplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RequestClarifications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RiskSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FinancialRiskAssessment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OperationalRiskAssessment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ComplianceRiskAssessment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RiskJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_HighRiskSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_DetailedInvestigation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RiskMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompileAuditReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReportMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateAuditReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DistributeFinalReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ArchiveReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_AuditClosed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AuditDirector" name="Audit Director">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewAuditReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ApprovalSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_AuditInitiated" name="Audit initiated"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendNotification" name="Send audit notification to regional office" messageRef="Msg_AuditNotification"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PrepSplit" name="Split preparation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFinancialStatements" name="Prepare financial statements"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherDocuments" name="Gather necessary documents"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates" name="Check regulatory updates affecting audit"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PrepJoin" name="Preparation complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitDocuments" name="Submit documents to central audit team"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReviewMerge" name="Submission received"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewSubmission" name="Review submission"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DiscrepancySplit" name="Discrepancies found?" default="Flow_NoDiscrepancies"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RequestClarifications" name="Request clarifications from regional office"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideClarifications" name="Provide necessary clarifications"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RiskSplit" name="Start risk assessment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinancialRiskAssessment" name="Evaluate financial risks"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OperationalRiskAssessment" name="Evaluate operational risks"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ComplianceRiskAssessment" name="Evaluate compliance risks"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RiskJoin" name="Risk assessment complete"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_HighRiskSplit" name="High risk identified?" default="Flow_NoHighRisk"/>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_DetailedInvestigation" name="Conduct detailed investigation">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Investigation"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_DataAnalysis" name="Perform data analysis"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_Interviews" name="Conduct interviews"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SiteVisitSplit" name="Site visit required?" default="Flow_NoSiteVisit"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SiteVisit" name="Conduct site visit"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SiteVisitMerge" name="Investigation activities done"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Investigation"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InvStart" sourceRef="StartEvent_Investigation" targetRef="Task_DataAnalysis"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InvAnalysisInterviews" sourceRef="Task_DataAnalysis" targetRef="Task_Interviews"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InvInterviewsSplit" sourceRef="Task_Interviews" targetRef="Gateway_SiteVisitSplit"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SiteVisitYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_SiteVisitSplit" targetRef="Task_SiteVisit">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${siteVisitRequired}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoSiteVisit" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_SiteVisitSplit" targetRef="Gateway_SiteVisitMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SiteVisitDone" sourceRef="Task_SiteVisit" targetRef="Gateway_SiteVisitMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InvEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_SiteVisitMerge" targetRef="EndEvent_Investigation"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RiskMerge" name="Risks addressed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompileAuditReport" name="Compile audit report"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportMerge" name="Report ready for review"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewAuditReport" name="Review audit report"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ApprovalSplit" name="Report approved?" default="Flow_RevisionsRequired"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateAuditReport" name="Update audit report with revisions"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DistributeFinalReport" name="Distribute final report to executive board"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ArchiveReport" name="Archive final report"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_AuditClosed" name="Audit process closed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_AuditInitiated" targetRef="Task_SendNotification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_SendNotification" targetRef="Gateway_PrepSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareFinancialStatements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFinancialStatements" targetRef="Task_GatherDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_GatherDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_PrepJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_PrepJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepJoin" targetRef="Task_SubmitDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_SubmitDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_ReviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewMerge" targetRef="Task_ReviewSubmission"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_ReviewSubmission" targetRef="Gateway_DiscrepancySplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DiscrepancyYes" name="Discrepancies found" sourceRef="Gateway_DiscrepancySplit" targetRef="Task_RequestClarifications">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${discrepanciesFound}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoDiscrepancies" name="No discrepancies" sourceRef="Gateway_DiscrepancySplit" targetRef="Gateway_RiskSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_RequestClarifications" targetRef="Task_ProvideClarifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_ProvideClarifications" targetRef="Gateway_ReviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskSplit" targetRef="Task_FinancialRiskAssessment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskSplit" targetRef="Task_OperationalRiskAssessment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskSplit" targetRef="Task_ComplianceRiskAssessment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_FinancialRiskAssessment" targetRef="Gateway_RiskJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_OperationalRiskAssessment" targetRef="Gateway_RiskJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_ComplianceRiskAssessment" targetRef="Gateway_RiskJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskJoin" targetRef="Gateway_HighRiskSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HighRiskYes" name="High risk" sourceRef="Gateway_HighRiskSplit" targetRef="SubProcess_DetailedInvestigation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${highRiskIdentified}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoHighRisk" name="No high risk" sourceRef="Gateway_HighRiskSplit" targetRef="Gateway_RiskMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="SubProcess_DetailedInvestigation" targetRef="Gateway_RiskMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskMerge" targetRef="Task_CompileAuditReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Task_CompileAuditReport" targetRef="Gateway_ReportMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportMerge" targetRef="Task_ReviewAuditReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Task_ReviewAuditReport" targetRef="Gateway_ApprovalSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_ApprovalSplit" targetRef="Task_DistributeFinalReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${approved}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RevisionsRequired" name="Revisions required" sourceRef="Gateway_ApprovalSplit" targetRef="Task_UpdateAuditReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="Task_UpdateAuditReport" targetRef="Gateway_ReportMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" sourceRef="Task_DistributeFinalReport" targetRef="Task_ArchiveReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_28" sourceRef="Task_ArchiveReport" targetRef="EndEvent_AuditClosed"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_AnnualAudit"/>
</bpmn:definitions>
